_note: Built-in coding / software-project preset — for agents that live in a codebase (Cursor, Claude Code, coding copilots) and must always know the project's CURRENT stack, not a stale one. Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:coding. Optionally VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=guardrail so project conventions are surfaced to the agent before it writes code. Nothing is confirm-gated: dev facts change constantly and should apply immediately. Stack choices are single-valued (a new one supersedes the old — 'we moved off Redux to Zustand' retires Redux); conventions, decisions, and services are lists.

slots.name: framework
slots.description: the main application or web framework (e.g. Next.js, Django, Rails, SwiftUI)

slots.name: state_library
slots.description: the frontend state-management library (e.g. Redux, Zustand, MobX, Jotai, Pinia)

slots.name: package_manager
slots.description: the package manager the project uses (e.g. npm, pnpm, yarn, uv, poetry, cargo)

slots.name: runtime_version
slots.description: the exact version of the language runtime (e.g. Node 20.11.0, Python 3.12)

slots.name: database
slots.description: the primary database or datastore (e.g. Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB)

slots.name: orm
slots.description: the ORM or data-access layer (e.g. Prisma, Drizzle, SQLAlchemy, ActiveRecord)

slots.name: api_style
slots.description: the API paradigm the project exposes or consumes (e.g. REST, GraphQL, tRPC, gRPC)

slots.name: styling
slots.description: the CSS / styling approach (e.g. Tailwind, CSS Modules, styled-components, vanilla-extract)

slots.name: auth_provider
slots.description: the authentication provider or method (e.g. Clerk, Auth0, NextAuth, Firebase Auth)

slots.name: deploy_target
slots.description: where the app is deployed / hosted (e.g. Vercel, Fly.io, AWS, Cloudflare, Render)

slots.name: ci_provider
slots.description: the CI/CD system (e.g. GitHub Actions, CircleCI, GitLab CI)

slots.name: test_runner
slots.description: the test framework / runner (e.g. Vitest, Jest, pytest, Playwright)

slots.name: build_tool
slots.description: the build tool or bundler (e.g. Vite, webpack, esbuild, Turbopack, Bazel)

slots.name: default_branch
slots.description: the repository's default / trunk branch (e.g. main, master, develop)

slots.name: external_service
slots.description: a third-party service or API the project integrates (e.g. Stripe, Sentry, Twilio) — a project uses several

slots.name: convention
slots.description: a coding standard or rule the project follows (e.g. tabs over spaces, PascalCase components, no default exports) — a project has several

slots.name: architecture_decision
slots.description: a recorded architectural / technical decision and its rationale (an ADR) — a project has several
